answer: Anchor each identity to a licensed bird-banding permit: each epoch the holder files a fresh sparrow banding record — band number, species, GPS, timestamp — checked against the national registry, one bander one vote. A band costs about $4 in rings plus a $25 yearly permit; a farm wanting 100 votes must field 100 licensed banders, since duplicate bands collapse to one vote and forged records burn the stake. A dune keeps its shape while shifting, and so does the registry: each epoch demands a fresh nonce-tagged record, so honest holders wander out once while a farm pays full cost per puppet.
